::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Nov 1st  [1888]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 10
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)

I think you must have heard from [Mrs Lennard](people/person_121.qmd) by this time, as she mentioned, in a letter I had yesterday, having heard from you. I was out all day and could not write.

[Miss Hugessen](people/person_820.qmd) is ill and cannot do her paper this month but there are to be retrospective questions. I think the same notice will do. I will write the notices but I think I shall have to ask for an additional sheet as so much has to be finished

A lady complains of a book by [the author](people/person_1467.qmd) of [Robert Elsmere](other_books/otherbook_631.qmd) being there advertised on [the Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) I mean.

Yours truly
C M Yonge
